name: Bellows Puff
notes: DRAFT for C13-2 (bestiary-plan.md). Huffs gusts that nudge you across the room. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: puffs up, then a pale gust arrow
senseiLine: The wind only pushes. Use it.
description: Huffs gusts that nudge you across the room.

lore.red: It used to fan the forge fire. Calm it, and it breathes gently to keep the forge warm.

bestiary.insight: Advanced: ride the push to slip away from a crowd.

push.note: No-damage push (Manager OK, C13). Push strength fixed; never into a hazard or off a ledge.
